name: Commerce Wise
description: Drupal Commerce offsite payment gateway for Wise Quick Pay. At checkout the shopper is redirected (GET) to a Wise Quick Pay payment link; Wise notifies the store via a webhook (onNotify), which maps the transfer reference to the order and records a completed payment. Configures a Wise @tag, Wise's webhook public key, account type, and test/live mode.
project_description:
This module integrates Drupal Commerce Core with Wise Quick Pay 

 Features 

 
 Offsite payment gateway in Drupal Commerce core. 
 Webhook integration for real time updates. 
 Payments in Drupal Commerce synchronized with Wise.com. 
 
 Requirements 

 This module should be added to your codebase via Composer

 composer require "drupal/commerce_wise:^1.0" 

 There are no other requirements than Commerce Core 3

 You must also have a Wise business account to configure for your integration.

You can sign up for one here .

 Configuration 

 See README for instructions how to configure Wise Quick Pay within Drupal Commerce Core
